title: indigo_agent_mcp: embedded help bundle is stale and test_agent_mcp expects the previous driver version
description:
Registered on the owner's request of 2026-11-20; both defects confirmed on master at d411033ba.

1. Stale help bundle. python3 indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/generate_help.py --check exits 1 with 'MCP help bundle is stale'. The checked-in indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/indigo_agent_mcp_help.h is generated from indigo_docs/mcp/*.md, indigo_docs/mcp/agents/*.md and indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.md; those sources were changed by later commits (for example cbbc6aedf and 47da62f95 of 2026-11-20) without regenerating the header. A make build regenerates it, but the checked-in copy is what the Visual Studio build and a reader of the repository get, and nothing runs --check. Regenerate the header. Find which source documents changed since the last regeneration and report them. Add the --check run to an existing hardware-free test target (indigo_test buildsystem tests) so that a forgotten regeneration fails a test; establish first whether the Windows build has any way to regenerate the header and state the result.

2. Version assertion. indigo_test/integration/test_agent_mcp.c:211 asserts info.version == 0x03000003 while indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/indigo_agent_mcp.c:42 defines DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000004 (raised by 85313ca07 of 2026-11-10), so the case 'idempotent automatic lifecycle' of make -C indigo_test test-agent-mcp fails. Reported during ticket e4cfbebb, not re-run since. Reproduce with test-agent-mcp, find out whether anything besides the stale constant fails, and fix the test; prefer not to hard-code a literal that must be edited with every version bump if the surrounding tests have a convention for it.

If the fix changes the behaviour of the driver, increment DRIVER_VERSION; regenerating the help header from changed documents changes what the agent serves, so decide and justify whether that counts. Do not edit README files. Verification: generate_help.py --check exits 0, test-agent-mcp and test-agent-mcp-sanitize pass with counts reported, test-buildsystem passes.

outcome.summary:
Header, guard test, test assertion and Xcode edit are correct; two small documentation fixes needed.
1. indigo_docs/MAKEFILES.md:45: the new MCP paragraph is inserted between the hexdump dependency paragraph (:43) and the paragraph at :47 that starts 'As with the generator, the tool is an order-only prerequisite ... these makefiles build it through indigo_tools'. That paragraph is about indigo_hexdump; it now directly follows the generate_help.py paragraph, so 'the tool' and 'these makefiles' read as generate_help.py / the agent_mcp Makefile, which is false (generate_help.py is a checked-in Python script, not built through indigo_tools, and is not run by any Xcode or Visual Studio step). Move the MCP paragraph to after :47 (end of the Embedded files section) or give it its own heading; text itself is accurate.
2. Version decision not justified in the ticket: the description asks to 'decide and justify' whether regenerating the header counts for DRIVER_VERSION; the implementer note only says 'DRIVER_VERSION not bumped'. Not bumping is defensible (agent_mcp code unchanged; make builds already regenerated the header in place and served this text since cbbc6aedf/47da62f95; only Xcode/VS builds change, to match), but record that justification with flow note.
Verified: generate_help.py --check exit 0 (18 documents); per-document decode of master vs branch header: preamble and metadata table identical, only mcp_help_text_13 (agents/sequencer.md) and _17 (reference/sequencer.md = Sequencer.md) differ, matching the only source changes since e61331cde; guard test in a git-archive copy outside the tree: OK clean, FAILED after editing a doc, with master's header, and with header missing, no files written; test-buildsystem Ran 21 OK; test-agent-mcp 1+25 make runs 34/34 each plus 40 direct runs under 12 busy loops, 0 failures (admission/unload case not reproduced); test-agent-mcp-sanitize 5 runs 34/34; assertion matches the INDIGO_DRIVER_API_GENERATION convention of test_agent_sc

Second round, full change reviewed at 952ab36f3 (git diff master...HEAD, 5 files). No defects. Round-1 items resolved: (1) the MCP paragraph is now the last paragraph of 'Embedded files' (MAKEFILES.md:47), so the hexdump order-only paragraph (:45) again follows the hexdump dependency paragraph; every statement checked against the build files: generate_help.py TOPICS/SOURCES match the three named source sets; indigo_drivers/agent_mcp/Makefile and indigo_test/Makefile:597-613 regenerate the header for test-agent-mcp and test-agent-mcp-sanitize; no Xcode shellScript phase (6 phases: hexdump and ctrlpanel only) and no step in indigo_agent_mcp.vcxproj/indigo_windows.sln/Directory.Build.props runs Python, the vcxproj only lists the header as ClInclude; test-buildsystem discovers test_*.py. (2) DRIVER_VERSION decision is recorded in a ticket note and its facts hold: 85313ca07 is the only change of indigo_agent_mcp.c since the help bundle (raised 0x03000003->0x03000004); 0422e2248, 4652c1d3e, ae4bb9925, bb0b9687d, e61331cde changed indigo_agent_mcp_help.h without touching DRIVER_VERSION; no agent_mcp code changes here; make builds already served this text. Header: generate_help.py --check exit 0 (18 documents) and its comparison is exact string equality with the generator output; decoding master vs branch header shows identical preamble and document table, only mcp_help_text_13 and _17 differ, matching git diff e61331cde master (agents/sequencer.md and agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.md only). Guard test: read-only, runs the real generator with sys.executable -B; in a git-archive copy outside the tree it passed clean and FAILED after editing agents/sequencer.md, with master's header, and after editing Sequencer.md. Assertion test_agent_mcp.c:211 now uses INDIGO_DRIVER_API_GENERATION, the convention of test_agent_scripting.c:412, test_agent_astrometry.c:697 and others. pbxproj: new ID unique (2 references), file in the buildsystem group only, plutil OK. Ran: make -C indigo

Round 3 (claude-opus-5-5, high), tree 70b9eefd7. No defects found.
Owner decisions: DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000004->0x03000005 (question answered 18:42Z), MCP_AGENT_VERSION '3.0.0.3'->'3.0.0.5' (owner note 18:43Z, incl. documents stating the version), README.md:23 only (answered 18:51Z). indigo_agent_mcp.c:42-43 and README.md:23 change exactly that; README test records :56-58 untouched; mcp.md:5 is the document stating the version. Both values higher than before.
Version statements: git grep for 3.0.0.x/0x030000x/serverInfo/MCP_AGENT_VERSION outside .factory2 finds only indigo_agent_mcp.c:42-43, README.md:23, mcp.md:5 (all 3.0.0.5) plus historical records README.md:56-58 and TEST_SUMMARY.md:35. CHANGELOG states no version.
Header: generate_help.py --check exit 0 (18 documents); per-document decode vs master: preamble and metadata table identical, only mcp_help_text_13 (agents/sequencer.md), 15 (agents/mcp.md), 17 (reference/sequencer.md = Sequencer.md) differ, matching the only source changes since e61331cde plus mcp.md:5. Generator unchanged; master has no source changes since the branch point.
Guard test (git-archive copy in scratch): OK clean; FAILED with a doc edited, with master's header and with the header missing; writes nothing (--check only, -B).
Assertion test_agent_mcp.c:211 uses INDIGO_DRIVER_API_GENERATION, the convention documented in indigo_test/AGENTS.md:211 and used by other tests.
